app.notes: New AQ look (Style tab, Look, AQ) and a new AQW-style app icon

changelog.notes:
New AQ look: Style tab, Look, AQ (gold + leather)
Boxy gold, red and dark buttons, AQ switches, leather panels, gold corners and a gold CHUD BOT logo (art made with ChatGPT)
Green-and-gold update banner
New app icon: the chud guy drawn in AQW style
Switch back to the Default look anytime

Check updates button in Log: tells you if you're up to date
What's new: this update log, from 0.4.0 to now
Update messages are green and start the update when you tap them
Items tab: sections by type (Classes, Weapons, Armors, Helms, Capes, Pets...) and a Type filter

Small notification: the bar matches the opened card (bot progress)
The farm count is pinned right, so it's never cut off
Shows "any monster" instead of *

Quests are accepted again after a disconnect, however you started them
Classes for bosses (1 target) and groups (2+ targets)
Auto attack enemies (Options)
Bot packets work like Grimoire: room id, room number and player name filled in

New app icon
Notification shows what the bot is farming (have / need) and your quest progress
Finished quests and items say Done and move to the bottom

Cleaner notification: text fits, one bar, picture inside the card
Notification colors follow your Style accent

Small notification back to normal size
Android 16+: fully open Live Update card on the lock screen
More info in the small notification
Clearing the app closes it fully, so it opens in landscape again (no more stuck portrait)
Close app button on the notification

Notifications and background running work (works around Android's add-on bug)
Pick which server to reconnect to (Bots tab)
Copy diagnostics button in Log, for fixing problems

Back hides the app instead of closing it, so the bot keeps going
Autostart button for Xiaomi phones

Renamed to Chud Bot
Drops decline properly, including items you already own
Checks for updates every minute
Live card on the lock screen: time, kills, gold earned
Stays silent in the background after a reconnect

Cleaner progress notification
Mutes the game when you leave the app, sound comes back when you return
Reconnects, goes home, then restarts the bot
Declines drops that aren't in the quest or the bot

GPU drawing for more FPS
Keeps running in the background with a progress notification

Remove all animations (damage numbers stay)
Pick up AC / non-AC drops and send them to the bank
Fixed overlapping menus

New look
Bot editor: change settings like the room number, and the commands (saved)
Classes tab: class per monster from your inventory
Public or private rooms
Smoother graphics

Update pop-ups without reopening the app
Style tab: colors, menu and button look

Bots update by themselves
Tap a .gbot file to open it in Chud Bot
Delete bots (with a "You sure?")

First Chud Bot: run your .gbot bots on your phone
Menu for bots, travel, options, packets, items, quests and the log
Import .gbot files from your phone
